threshold.value: Threshold shall not apply with respect to Counterparty. With respect to Morgan, Threshold is determined by Credit Ratings: Infinity if S&P is A-1 or above, Moody's long-term senior unsecured debt is A1 or above, or Moody's short-term senior unsecured debt is P-1 or above; US$0 if S&P is Below A-1, Moody's long-term is Below A1 or A1 on negative watch, or Moody's short-term is Below P-1 or P-1 on negative watch; U.S.$0 if Morgan has no Credit Rating or an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing with respect to Morgan.
threshold.evidence_quote: "Threshold" shall not apply with respect to the Counterparty and, with respect to Morgan, shall mean the amounts determined on the basis of the lower of the Credit Ratings set forth in the following table, provided, however, that if (i) Morgan has no Credit Rating, or (ii) an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing with respect to Morgan, Morgan's Threshold shall be U.S.$0:

minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: "Minimum Transfer Amount", with respect to a party on any Valuation Date, means U.S. $250,000.

rounding.value: Rounded up and down to the nearest integral multiple of $100,000, respectively.
rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount and the Return Amount will be rounded up and down to the nearest integral multiple of $100,000, respectively.

governing_law.value: the law specified as the Governing Law in the Schedule to the Agreement
governing_law.evidence_quote: This Amendment shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with the law specified as the Governing Law in the Schedule to the Agreement
